contentRulesData.title: Content
userContentText: You are solely responsible for the content you publish in mommi, such as images, posts, comments and messages.

Do not publish content that violates these terms of use, is illegal or may cause harm to other individuals. You are also responsible for ensuring that the information you share in your profile or in the app is accurate and up to date.
Content that you publish may be visible to other users. Therefore, be careful when sharing personal information.

By publishing content in mommi, you confirm that you have the right to share it and grant us the right to store, display and use the content for the purpose of providing and operating the app’s functionality.
We may review, restrict or remove content that we consider violates these terms of use or may harm other users or the service.
otherUsersText: mommi stores and displays content published by other users, but we are not responsible for whether the information is accurate, complete or up to date.
Content shared by other users may be inaccurate, biased, offensive or misleading. You are solely responsible for assessing and verifying information before making decisions based on it.
Users may only use member content in accordance with the purpose of the app — to communicate, create connections and participate in activities within mommi.
You may not copy, distribute, sell, use for marketing, harass or otherwise misuse other users’ content.
Misuse of member content may result in your account being restricted or suspended.
platformContentText: All content in mommi, including but not limited to logos, trademarks, design, graphics, texts, images, features and source code, is owned by Andersson & Hensfelt HB or licensed to us and protected by applicable law.
Without our written permission, you may not copy, modify, distribute, reproduce, reuse or otherwise exploit our content beyond what is required to use the service in accordance with these terms.
All rights not expressly granted in these terms are reserved by us.
reportingText: We do not accept inappropriate content or behaviour in mommi.
If you discover content or behaviour that violates our rules, we encourage you to report it through the app’s reporting function or by contacting us.
We may immediately remove content, restrict features or suspend accounts that we consider violate these terms of use.

sections.subtitle: Privacy
text: Your privacy is important to us - we therefore have a separate privacy policy that we recommend all our users to read.
For information about how Mommi collects, uses and shares your personal data, please refer to the aforementioned privacy policy.
By using our services, you agree that we process your personal data in accordance with the privacy policy.

sections.subtitle: Children's privacy
text: The app is intended for mothers and users may therefore choose to share content relating to their children, for example through images or posts.
When you publish content relating to a child, you are responsible for ensuring that this is done respectfully and that the child’s privacy is protected.
You may only share content that you have the right to publish and that cannot be harmful, offensive or inappropriate for the child.

sections.subtitle: Rights you grant to mommi
text: You own the content that you publish in mommi.
By publishing content in the service, you grant us a non-exclusive and royalty-free right to store, display and process the content for the purpose of providing and developing the service.
The license applies as long as the content is available in the service and terminates when it is removed, with the exception of reasonable storage in backups for a limited period of time.
You are responsible for ensuring that the content you publish does not infringe anyone else’s rights or violate the law.

sections.subtitle: Termination of account
text: You may terminate your account at any time through the settings in the app.
We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms or otherwise misuse the service.
Certain provisions of these terms continue to apply even after the account has been terminated.
Processing and deletion of personal data takes place in accordance with our privacy policy.

sections.subtitle: Security and responsibility
text: mommi does not conduct background checks or identity verification of users.
You are solely responsible for your interactions with other users and should always use good judgment when communicating with or meeting people through the service.
We are not responsible for the behaviour of other users within or outside the service.
If you experience inappropriate behaviour, we encourage you to use our reporting functions.
We reserve the right to take action, including suspending or terminating accounts that violate our terms or act in a manner contrary to the purpose of the service.

sections.subtitle: Disclaimer of liability
text: mommi is provided as is and subject to availability.
We strive to ensure that the service functions in a reliable and secure manner, but we cannot guarantee that the service will always be free from interruptions, errors or technical issues.
We provide no guarantees regarding the accuracy, completeness or suitability of the content for a particular purpose.
Use of the service is at your own risk.
mommi is not responsible for content published by users or for the behaviour of other users within or outside the service.
We are also not responsible for indirect damages or losses arising from the use of the service, to the extent permitted under applicable law.
Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited under law.

sections.subtitle: Advertisements and third-party content
text: mommi may display advertisements or other third-party content within the service.
We are not responsible for content, offers or services provided by third parties.
If you choose to interact with an advertiser or leave the service via an external link, the third party’s own terms and privacy policy will apply.

sections.subtitle: Applicable law and disputes
text: These terms are governed by Swedish law.
If a dispute arises, the parties shall first attempt to resolve it through dialogue.
If the dispute cannot be resolved amicably, it shall be settled by a Swedish general court.
Consumers also have the right to refer disputes to the Swedish National Board for Consumer Disputes (ARN) for review.

sections.subtitle: Changes to the terms of use
text: We may update these terms of use to reflect changes in our services, legal requirements or how we conduct our business.
For minor changes, the updated version will be published in the app.
For material changes, we will notify you through the app or via email before the changes take effect.
The latest version of the terms is always available in the app.
By continuing to use mommi after the changes have taken effect, you accept the updated terms.

userResponsibilitiesData.title: Your responsibilities
intro: Before creating an account in mommi, you must ensure that you are eligible to use our services. This section describes who may use the app and what responsibilities you have when using mommi.
You may not create an account or use mommi unless all of the following conditions are fulfilled.
userResponsibilitiesData.confirmTitle: By using the app, you confirm that:
confirmList: You are a natural person (not a company or other legal entity).
You are at least 18 years old.
You are legally capable of entering into a binding agreement with Andersson & Hensfelt Handelsbolag.
You have not previously been suspended or removed from the mommi application due to violations of our rules, unless you have received explicit permission to create a new account.
You have not committed or been convicted of serious crimes involving violence, threats of violence or sexual offences.
The information you provide when creating your account is accurate and up to date.
confirmText: If at any time you no longer meet these requirements, your right to use mommi ceases. We reserve the right to restrict or terminate your access to the service without prior notice if we determine that these conditions are not fulfilled.
userResponsibilitiesData.agreeTitle: When using mommi, you agree to:
agreeList: Comply with applicable laws and regulations, including laws relating to privacy, intellectual property and harassment.
Use the app in a respectful and responsible manner.
Treat other users kindly and respectfully, both within the app and at any meetups organised through mommi.
Not use the app for harassment, threats, discrimination or other inappropriate behaviour.
Immediately notify us if you suspect unauthorised use of your account.
Present yourself accurately and respectfully in your profile.
You are responsible for all activity that occurs through your account.
revokeText: If you no longer fulfil these requirements, your entire authorisation to access the mommi application is automatically revoked. You must then immediately delete your account from the app.
userResponsibilitiesData.prohibitedTitle: When using mommi, you agree that you will not:
prohibitedList: Publish images or other content that places children in danger.
Provide false or misleading information about your identity.

Encourage or facilitate activities that may cause harm to other users, including but not limited to self-harm behaviour, eating disorders, dangerous challenges, extremism or the spread of harmful or misleading information.
Upload content that may be considered offensive or violate another person’s dignity, is pornographic, violent or contains nudity.
Upload content involving racism, sexism or hatred.

Publish content for commercial purposes, including advertising, marketing, sales posts, recruitment, spam or collaborations without our explicit approval. Commercial use of the app may only take place through an approved collaboration with mommi.
Harass, bully or stalk other users.
Create an account after we have suspended or terminated your account.
Submit a report regarding another user or their content that is false or misleading.
Upload, share or distribute content containing viruses, malicious code or other technology that may damage, disrupt or affect the functionality of the app, our systems or other users’ devices.

introductionTermsData.title: Introduction
text: By using the mommi application, you agree to the following terms of use, including our privacy policy and safety advice. It is therefore important that you read this carefully before creating your account.
These terms of use govern your use of the mommi mobile application and the services provided through it.
If you do not accept the terms, you must not use the application.
We encourage all users to pay attention to their own safety when using mommi and when meeting other members. We therefore recommend that you review our safety advice before using the app.
The application is provided by Andersson & Hensfelt Handelsbolag (company registration number 969801-6434).
definitions: In these terms of use, "mommi", "the app", "the application" or "the service" refers to the mommi mobile application provided by Andersson & Hensfelt Handelsbolag.
When we use "we", "us" or "our", this refers to Andersson & Hensfelt Handelsbolag.
When we use "you", "your" or "user", this refers to the person using the mommi app.
